name: Shanghai Jiao Tong University
englishBachelors: Limited. Some English-taught tracks exist in engineering and medicine; the SJTU-ParisTech Elite Institute of Technology teaches in French and Chinese. Verify directly.
note: A large engineering-led university in Shanghai, and the institution that created the Academic Ranking of World Universities. It runs joint institutes with Michigan and with ParisTech; the ParisTech one teaches in French and Chinese.
